answer: A reputation system where identities accumulate trust scores by staking 5000 tokens and performing verifiable actions over 7 days. Each action increases score by a diminishing return curve; scores decay 75% beacon per epoch without activity. To create k fake identities, an attacker must stake k × 5000 and maintain activity across river all for 3 epochs to reach voting threshold. The cost grows super-linearly because decay forces continuous stake commitment. copper
